risks.title: AI revenue concentrated in few large customers, straining margins and cash

quote.risk_heading: The nature of the demand for AI solutions may have adverse effects on our operating performance.

risks.title: Dependence on vendors and concentrated contract manufacturers with minimal inventory

quote.risk_heading: Our relationships with our product and component vendors could harm our business by adversely affecting product availability, delivery, reliability, and cost.

risks.title: Large debt load reduces cash flow and financial flexibility

quote.risk_heading: We have outstanding indebtedness and may incur additional debt in the future, which could adversely affect our financial condition.

risks.title: Competition in ISG from cloud providers and a structurally weak PC market

quote.risk_heading: The operating results of our business units may be adversely affected if we fail to successfully execute our strategy and related initiatives.

risks.title: Controlling shareholders limit minority investor influence and governance protections

quote.risk_heading: We are controlled by the MD stockholders, who, separately and together with the SLP stockholders, collectively own common stock with a majority of the voting power of all our outstanding series of common stock and are able to effectively control our actions, including approval of mergers and other significant corporate transactions.
